description: The article operationalizes dialogue through four Bakhtin-inspired themes used both to train teachers and to analyze noticing utterances.
title: Bakhtinian dialogic framework of four interconnected themes — voices, expanding the dialogue, inter-animation, and relations

description: The paper recommends that studies using student achievement outcomes generally aim to collect and use baseline data, because analyses using more than one wave of data typically have much greater statistical power than posttest-only analyses.
title: Baseline covariate adjustment in education randomized trials

description: Bayesian Networks are presented as both a specification language and a computational mechanism with practical value in designing group and learning support systems: they have \"been frequently used to build student models (Millán et al., 2010) and for assessment (Almond et al., 2015)\".
title: Bayesian Networks for student modelling, assessment, and collaborative learning theory

description: A novel methodological approach in which each yoked participant observes the responses of an \"ideal Bayesian learner\" personalized to have that participant's individual prior beliefs.
title: Bayesian Yoking Procedure
